content: Vona Tana‑minikuna Ahahaba Ai Yau 10 Wayahi

Iesu yana vona mamanaina eha ta‑iakwa, ka neine, ivona, “Auyewaia nihenia Yaubada ya pai veimea wahuma taina deina. Ahahaba ai yau 10 imamaei, ka aitamoata aitamoata wayahia yai lampaV iepei, e ini‑ubau iopu tau tavine ipotepotei.
Ka taui wayahia ahahaba ai yau 5 yai nua‑uya nui, ka ahahaba ai yau 5 mwagemwagei.
Ka taui mwagemwagei yai lampaV iepei, kate eha daudau wayahi itꞌ‑epe.
Kate taui yai nua‑uya nui yai lampaV kadue daudau na gamna nui iepei.
Ka habuhabui tau tavine‑nana ipotapota‑wayohei, ka tauna eha ta‑vo‑kwayavoni. Wayahina, habuhabui idauva iaino‑ainei.
Ka ioyoma pouna movina ananina inononi, ivona, ‘Tau tavine omomoi! Unꞌ‑omo unau‑vi‑taui!’
Ka ahahaba‑naia habuhabui imini, e yai lampaV ivo‑vi‑aiaia.
Ka taui mwagemwagei yaiai iviamei, ivona, ‘Aioi! Itoai yama daudau avaha iakwa. Wayahina, yami daudau uvo‑patai. Iuna yama lampaV iweuweu.’
Ka taui yai nua‑uya nui inau‑patei, ivona, ‘Eha ama pata aivaitemi. Iuna ama daudau eha ana pata habuhabuka wayahika. Itomi uvisina una‑ne tau aimwane daudau wayahina, ka yami daudau uvi‑maiei.’

Wayahina, taui mwagemwagei yaiai ini‑tawanei, e ineine etawana, ka tuta aitamoata wayahina tau tavine‑nana vinꞌ‑omo. Taui yai nua‑uya nui ai yau 5 avaha ivo‑vi‑aiai. Wayahina, tau tavine‑nana nui manua inui, ka manuana a tau paisewa awana gudu‑potei. Iakwa, e tavine anianina ivi‑putu, idewa‑haiawa.
Ka munia, taui mwagemwagei imavina, e awana wayahina imimini, itutu‑keakeana, ivi‑honehone, iviama, ivonavona, ‘Bada, Bada! Kaiwa ananina. Memeanina awana ewaei wayahiai?’
Ka tau tavine‑nana vona‑nau‑patei, ivona, ‘Memeanina nuami vi‑tupatupa, kate avonemi, eha atꞌ‑anamanemi.’
Wayahina, viviwavana unuani, ka udune‑vivinimi. Iuna itomi eha yau mavina anꞌ auyewa utꞌ‑anamane, kadu eha yau mavi‑havine a babau utꞌ‑anamane.
Vona Tana‑minikuna Tau Paisewa Aitonu Wayahi

Ka kadu aitam vona tana‑minikuna avenemi, e Yaubada ya pai veimea wahuma wayahina unꞌ‑anamanei. Aitam tuta onoto kaikaiwabona mamaei. Ka tauna kadu tau vi‑manua aitam. Ka tauna ya tau paisewa aitonu hone‑hohoni, e ivona, ‘Yauke yau nae ana tuta avaha omoi. Ka ataina yau gugua kadu yau kina atana‑vewani avenemi, e itomi udune‑vi‑avini ataina a itoava amavina wayahina.’

Ka tau paisewa naona honei, e talenita ai yau 5 venei, e vꞌ‑inuana talenita ai yau 2 venei, e vꞌ‑itonuna talenita aitamoata venei, aitonu ai pata deina. Iakwa, e kaikaiwabona ni‑tawanei ine mani papani wayahina.
Ka vo‑kwayavonina, tau paisewa naona ya talenita epei, ine, e vi‑putu paipaisewa. Ka munia ya paisewa wayahina kadue talenita ai yau 5 hetana vaniahei.
Ka deinake, tau paisewa vꞌ‑inuana ya talenita epei, ine, e vi‑putu paipaisewa. Ka munia ya paisewa wayahina kadue talenita ai yau 2 hetana vaniahei.
Kate tau paisewa vꞌ‑itonuna ya talenita epei, ine, e guba tanopia ikayo, e ya talenita na kodena pai vi‑ai tanopia tavuni.
Ka tuta mamanaina munia, kaikaiwabo‑nana mavina. Ka ya tau paisewa hone‑hohoni, e medeina yai dewa nꞌ‑anamanei.

Ka tau paisewa naona vinꞌ‑omoi, e ivona, ‘Kauvea, kaiwa ananina. Nonova evitumahaneu, e talenita ai yau 5 eveneu adune‑vi‑avini wayahim. Ka yau paisewa wayahina kadue talenita ai yau 5 hetana avaniahei. Wayahina, ataina habuhabuna talenita ai yau 10 avene‑havinem.’

Ka tau paisewana ya kauvea ivona, ‘Kaiwa ananina. Taum yam dewa ahiahina kadu tunuhina. Nonova gugua tupwai avenem edune‑vi‑avini, ka avaha edune‑vi‑avini ahiahina. Wayahina, ataina gugua habuhabuna avenem eveimeyei. Enꞌ‑omoi, e nui kadewa‑haiawa!’

Ka tau paisewa vꞌ‑inuana vinꞌ‑omoi, e ivona, ‘Kauvea, kaiwa ananina. Nonova evitumahaneu, e talenita ai yau 2 eveneu adune‑vi‑avini wayahim. Ka yau paisewa wayahina kadue talenita ai yau 2 hetana avaniahei. Wayahina, ataina habuhabuna talenita ai yau 4 avene‑havinem.’

Ka tau paisewana ya kauvea ivona, ‘Kaiwa ananina. Taum yam dewa ahiahina kadu tunuhina. Nonova gugua tupwai avenem edune‑vi‑avini, ka avaha edune‑vi‑avini ahiahina. Wayahina, ataina gugua habuhabuna avenem eveimeyei. Enꞌ‑omoi, e nui kadewa‑haiawa!’

Ka pai nau‑yehata wayahina, tau paisewa vꞌ‑itonuna vinꞌ‑omoi, e ivona, ‘Kauvea, avaha anamanem, wamke yam dewa eha tunuhina. Iuna tuta tuta baguna eaiaihana, kate bagunaia eha eta‑baguna. Ka manimaninim deinake.
Wayahina, amatamatautem. Akaka, ane, e guba tanopia aikayoi, e yam talenita atavuni tanopia. Ataina yam talenita avene‑havinem.’
Ka tau paisewana ya kauvea magana bawe wayahina, ka ivona, ‘Ia! Taum goyogoyom, kadu eupu‑tonetonem! Avaha eanamaneu yauke baguna aiaihana, kate eha bagunaia ata‑baguna, a?
Aituhu avaha enuanua deina, wamke nau‑wawanim nonova yau talenita enꞌ‑epe, e mani tomotau ena‑vo‑patai, e ataina ina‑vene‑havinem ka tupwana hetana nui.’
Ka kaikaiwabo‑nana mani tau paisewa honei ka veimeyei, ivona, ‘Onoto taina ya talenita uvitua‑yavunei, e una‑ne, e tauna avaha talenita ai yau 10 wayahina uvenei.’

Iuna aituhu aviyaivia kikituna nimaia mamaei, ka aituhu yai dewa tunutunuhina, apaina taui ahiahina ivaniahei hetana. Kate aituhu aviyaivia kikituna nimaia mamaei, ka aituhu yai dewa eha tunutunuhina, apaina aviani kikituna nonova nimaia mamaei avitua‑yavunei.
Akanai, tau paisewana goyogoyona yau manua upuna uhaponei. Papani‑nana novanovanina, ka papani‑nana wayahina tomotau na inahei itoutou, kadu na inahei nihoi ina‑utaiei.
Vitana Matana Pai Nau‑yehata

Auyewana wayahina yauke, Tauna Vi‑tomotau, amavi‑havine, avinꞌ‑omo yau anelose nui kadu didigau nui. Ka didigau wahuma wayahina nui yau pai manuena ahihi‑vainena hetana amanuena, e avi‑putu aveimeyei.
Ka tau maꞌ tanopi habuhabui inau‑hohona wayahiua. E habuhabui atana‑vewani, sipiV ai tau dune‑vi‑avina yai dewa deina, tutana taui yai sipiV itana‑vewani vahitau ana wava gotiV wayahia.
E yau sipiV ateiua abouni, ka gotiV akeniua abouni.

Na‑iakwa, e yauke, yai kiniV, taui ateiua avonei, ana‑vona, ‘Itomi avaha nau‑iaiava Amau wayahina uvaniahei. Unꞌ‑omoi, e yami gabu unꞌ‑epei. Nonova, tutana Yaubada dewa habuhabuna vevewanei, tauna kadue pai maꞌ vo‑vi‑aiaia wayahimi. Ka natunatuna aitamoata aitamoata nau‑wawani pai maꞌ‑nana ivaniahei.
Iuna tutana yauke am navovo, aniani uveneveneu. Ka tutana magau ayaya, pai nim uveneveneu. Ka tutana yauke abwanibwani, eha yau manua, uvaniahau, e uvoneu, “Evane‑mei, baina emamaei.”
Ka tutana yauke eha au kwama, ami kwama uvo‑patau. Ka tutana avi‑kwanaha, udune‑nuanuaieu, udune‑viviniu. Ka tutana yauke manua yohona nihenina yohoyohoniu amamaei, uomomo wayahiua unau‑vi‑tau.’
Ka taui tunutunuhi vona inau‑patau, ina‑vona, ‘Kauvea, kaiwadi, avi tuta wayahina adueyem am enavovo, e aniani avenem, o kadi magam ayaya, e pai nim avenem?
Kaiwadi, avi tuta wayahina adueyem evi‑tau bwanibwani, avonem, “Evane‑mei, baina emamaei,” o avi tuta wayahina adueyem eha am kwama, e ama kwama avo‑patam?
Ka kaiwadi, avi tuta wayahina adueyem evi‑kwanaha, o manua yohona nihenina yohoyohonim emamaei, e anau‑vi‑taum?’
Ka yauke, yai kiniV, ana‑vona, ‘Memeanina nuami vi‑tupatupa, kate avonemi, nonova avi dewa ahiahina udedewei vavaneiu ai wava kikitui wayahi, akanai dewaia udedewei taua wayahiu deinake.’

Na‑iakwa, e taui akeniua ana‑vona, ‘Itomi uni‑tawaneu! Itomi nau‑iaiava Amau wayahina uvihahaiei. Wayahina, avaha bwanata taina uvaniahei. Akanai una‑ne ai ananata‑vavaha nihenina. Yaubada yami pai maꞌ vo‑vi‑aiaia Satana tauna yanꞌ anelose nui wayahi.
Iuna yauke am navovo, ka eha aitam aviani uta‑veneu anꞌ‑am. Ka magau ayaya, ka eha aitam aviani uta‑veneu ana‑nim.

Ka yauke abwanibwani, ka eha uta‑voneu, “Evane‑mei, baina emamaei.” Ka yauke eha au kwama, kate eha ami kwama uta‑nau‑patau. Ka yauke avi‑kwanaha, kadu yauke manua yohona nihenina yohoyohoniu amamaei, kate itomi eha uta‑dune‑viviniu.’

Ka taui ina‑vona, ‘Kauvea, kaiwadi, avi tuta wayahina adueyem am enavovo, o magam ayaya? O avi tuta wayahina adueyem ebwanibwani, o eha am kwama? O avi tuta wayahina adueyem evi‑kwanaha, o manua yohona nihenina emamaei?’

Ka yauke ana‑vona, ‘Memeanina nuami vi‑tupatupa, kate avonemi, nonova avi dewa ahiahina nau‑wawanimi udedewe vavaneiu ai wava kikitui wayahi, ka uvihahaiei, eha uta‑dewe, akanai uvihahaieu deinake, eha uta‑dewe wayahiu.’
Ka taui goyogoyoi ai nau‑pata dewa‑yaiyai‑vavaha ivaniahei deina. Ka taui tunutunuhi ai nau‑pata yawai‑vavaha ivaniahei deina.”
